text.p: Tunisian detergents firm Societe des Produits Chimiques Detergents said it started on Monday distributing a 0.5 dinar dividend per share on its results for 1996.
Dividend per share distributed for 1995 results was 1.15 dinar.

The firm's net profits for 1996 amounted to 3.049 million dinars, slightly up from 3.015 million dinars in 1995, final results showed. Turnover amounted to 28.52 million dinars in 1996, up by 10.6 percent from 25.78 million dinars in 1995.
Detergents production volume was 28,182 tonnes, up by 7.4 percent from 26,246 tonnes.
SPCD last year raised its capital to six million dinars from four million dinars through incorportation of reserves.

The company is listed at the Tunis Stock Exchange since last year after it sold to the public 80,000 shares, 14,000 of which were bought by four foreign institutional investors in the first ever sale of shares to foreigners.
SPCD share was last priced 33.7 dinars. ($=1.096 dinar) --Tunis newsroom: 2161-787538
